The approval requires the affirmative vote of a majority of the ordinary shares present and entitled to vote at the meeting. Abstentions and broker non-votes have no effect on the outcome. This vote is non-binding but the Board will consider the outcome in future compensation decisions.

items.title: Ratification of selection of Ernst & Young LLP as independent registered public accounting firm
items.summary: Stockholders are asked to ratify the Audit Committee's appointment of Ernst & Young LLP as the Company's independent registered public accounting firm for the fiscal year ending May 1, 2027. The ratification requires the affirmative vote of a majority of the ordinary shares present and entitled to vote at the meeting. Abstentions and broker non-votes have no effect on the outcome. If not ratified, the Audit Committee will reconsider its selection.

items.title: Election of six director nominees for one-year terms
items.summary: Stockholders are asked to elect six directors to hold office until the next annual meeting or until their successors are elected and qualified. The nominees are Rhea J. Posedel, Gayn Erickson, Fariba Danesh, Laura Oliphant, Geoffrey G. Scott, and Howard T. Slayen. The Board recommends voting FOR the election of all nominees.

items.title: Ratification of appointment of BPM LLP as independent registered public accounting firm for fiscal 2027
items.summary: Stockholders are asked to ratify the appointment of BPM LLP as the Company's independent registered public accounting firm for the fiscal year ending June 25, 2027. Representatives of BPM LLP are expected to be present at the meeting and available to respond to questions. The Board recommends voting FOR this ratification.
